text:
elaine (procurement): Sigma just flagged 9 H200s on PO-82190 as 'RMA-park' due to connector batch mismatch. ETA moved 2w -> 5w. They offered split release + loaner options.
rob (supply-ops): Which region? EU DC?
elaine (procurement): Yes, EU DC. Felix said 3 units can be released in 10 days after bench tests, remaining 6 in 5w.
nina (eng-infra): Losing 9 will hit our EU dedicated pool throughput for nightly batches. Approx 15% throughput loss. Can we borrow from US without hurting customers?
rob (supply-ops): Cross-region borrow costs ~€2k/week for replication + egress. Compare to expedited loaner cost.
carter (logistics): Loaners available from Sigma: refurbished units with immediate dispatch. Fee: €95/day/unit + expedited freight €420 flat. Customs for refurb might need extra docs.
felix (vendor_sigma): Confirming. We can also waive refurb courier fee if you commit to next quarter allocation. We will provide serials and preflight logs today.
elaine (procurement): Proposal: accept 3 immediate verified units, take 6 loaners for 4 weeks, negotiate 6% invoice credit on delayed 6. Legal to draft addendum.
rob (supply-ops): +1. Also ask vendor to include serial list now so node-tagging doesn't break.
felix (vendor_sigma): I'll send serials + firmware diff by EOD and cc legal.
carter (logistics): Once serials in, I'll book DAP courier and prepare split AWBs. Ops-bot: create ticket.
ops-bot: Ticket INF-8833 created: "Vendor Sigma H200 RMA-park split release + loaner coordination". Assignees: carter, rob, elaine. Link: https://redwood.internal/tickets/INF-8833
nina (eng-infra): Also request a short firmware mitigation checklist. If it's connector-only we might gate on a config flag.
felix (vendor_sigma): We'll include a mitigation note. Thanks.
elaine (procurement): I'll loop in Finance after addendum draft. Cheers.
